lead: A clickable button: its behaviour comes from Base UI, its look from the current theme style. The examples follow the Button page of the HeroUI docs, with HeroUI's variants written as `variant` + `color` here. To join several buttons into one, see [Button Group](/button-group).

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: How HeroUI's primary / secondary / tertiary / outline / ghost / danger / danger-soft are written in this package.

with-icons.title: With Icons
with-icons.description: Icons go in `startContent` / `endContent`, one slot each.

loading.title: Loading
loading.description: With `loading`, the start slot shows a spinner: the button ignores clicks but stays focusable.

social-buttons.title: Social Buttons
social-buttons.description: The brand icons use the same paths as the OAuth sign-in page.

render-function.title: Render Function
render-function.description: Base UI's `render`: render the button as another element, such as a link. A non-native button also needs `nativeButton={false}`.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: HeroUI v3 has no `color`. This is the full `variant` × `color` matrix of this package, to check that each theme style covers all of it.

behaviour.title: Behaviour
behaviour.description: The behaviour must not change with the theme style: clicking the disabled and loading buttons keeps their counts at 0, and Tab focuses them, to check the focus styles.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: The component has no styles. It only writes the hooks below, which theme styles style with attribute selectors such as `[data-skein-theme="x"] [data-slot="button"][data-variant="solid"]`.
styling.slot: Structure hook: theme styles select each part with it
styling.variants: Variant hooks, only passing the values through; `data-radius` appears only when `radius` is passed (or set by the group)
styling.disabled: Written by Base UI when disabled
